items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because I guess from what I've read, Don really wasn't getting much work. So .Blakey said come on with me and I guess they went to Japan, I heard. [INTERVIEWEE] Together, uh huh.

ctx.x: did a couple more concerts and got a few more dollars in his pocket, then's when he started getting wild, drinking again and thinking that Harlem was the same place that he left 24 years ago and it wasn't, until somebody called Eddie Barefield and says, 'oh man, come up here and get your man. He's up here at Basie's place, which was 132nd and 7th Avenue and he's up here going wild, flashing his money and all that.' So I guess Eddie and them went up there and got him and took him home and I didn't hear no more…
Well I guess Art Blakey had him tour with his group for a little while.
